steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the basic directory and file structure for the new Welcome App project.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Create app-meta.json to store the 'Welcome App' name and 'com.welcomeapp.app' package name.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml for 'Welcome App', declaring its package, application label, main activity, and intent filter. Ensure correct Android namespace and icon reference.

steps.title: Set up Project-Level Gradle
steps.description: Configure the project-level build.gradle for the Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) and common settings.

steps.title: Configure App-Level Gradle
steps.description: Create app/build.gradle, specifying 'com.welcomeapp.app' as the application ID, setting SDK versions (min 21, target 34, compile 34), and using AGP 8.3.2 compatible settings.

steps.title: Create Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml layout to display a 'Welcome' text view in the center using a RelativeLayout.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Java Code
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java under the 'com.welcomeapp.app' package to extend android.app.Activity and set activity_main.xml as its content view upon creation.

steps.title: Review AndroidManifest for Consistency
steps.description: Verify that the MainActivity is correctly declared in AndroidManifest.xml with the appropriate package and intent filters.

steps.title: Final Code Review
steps.description: Perform a final check of all generated files to ensure compliance with Java 8, specified Gradle/SDK versions, and Android build rules, ensuring no forbidden dependencies or features are present.

steps.title: Building Welcome App
steps.description: Initiate the Gradle build process to compile, assemble, and package the 'Welcome App' into an APK.
